name: ticketing-tutorials
description: Scripted tutorial video recordings for the Ticketing System (Client & Employee journeys)

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright-core install ffmpeg
scripts.fresh:client: npm run cleanup && npm run seed && npm run record:client && npm run voiceover
scripts.fresh:employee: npm run cleanup && npm run seed && npm run record:employee && npm run voiceover
scripts.fresh:all: npm run cleanup && npm run seed && npm run record && npm run voiceover
